question: g1_delete_item
answer:
Fixed. The one-line change is in [cartActions.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/no_okf/work/g1_delete_item/no_okf/codex/4/src/redux/actions/cartActions.js:163).

**Why it failed:** `deleteFromCart` built the URL as `DELETE /api/v1/cart/{code}/product/{id}` using `item.id`. But the backend's cart API (`ShoppingCartApi.deleteCartItem`) defines the endpoint as `DELETE /cart/{code}/product/{sku}` — it looks the item up by **SKU** (`removeShoppingCartItem(cartCode, sku, ...)`), and cart items in the `GET /cart/{code}` response carry `sku`, not a usable `id`. So the request went out with the wrong (undefined/incorrect) product key, the backend rejected it, and the error was swallowed in the `catch`, leaving the item in the cart. The fix is to send `item.sku` in the path — which also matches how `addToCart` in the same file already identifies products (`product: item.sku`).

**Files used:**
- [src/redux/actions/cartActions.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/no_okf/work/g1_delete_item/no_okf/codex/4/src/redux/actions/cartActions.js) — the only file changed
- [src/util/constant.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/no_okf/work/g1_delete_item/no_okf/codex/4/src/util/constant.js) and [src/util/webService.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/no_okf/work/g1_delete_item/no_okf/codex/4/src/util/webService.js) — to see the final URL and request mechanics
- [src/pages/other/Cart.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/no_okf/work/g1_delete_item/no_okf/codex/4/src/pages/other/Cart.js) and [src/components/header/sub-components/MenuCart.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/no_okf/work/g1_delete_item/no_okf/codex/4/src/components/header/sub-components/MenuCart.js) — call sites, to confirm what's passed as `item`
- `ShoppingCartApi.java` from the Shopizer backend repo (fetched from GitHub) — the authoritative endpoint definition that pinned down `{sku}` vs `{id}`
